title: Release rollout + canary scratchpad
content:
Purpose / context:
- Rough personal notes for the 2026.02 runtime release (v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0) rollout. Intended to capture the canary plan, quick rollback paths, and outstanding questions before I turn this into the formal release checklist doc for SRE/Product.

High-level goals:
- Deploy v2.15.0 with the new KV-cache eviction fix and kernel selection tweak that improves p50 latency for long-context requests.
- Run progressive canary to 10% traffic, monitor latency/error budgets, then 50% if stable, then full.
- Ensure safe fallback to v2.14.0 using model-compatible variant routing if regressions occur.

Key invariants (must hold):
- No customer-visible increase in 95th/99th latency > 15% over baseline for 10m windows.
- Error rate (5xx and request failures) must not exceed baseline + 0.1% absolute.
- No silent data leak — confirm KMS/HSM integrations unchanged.

Canary plan (quick sketch):
1) Predeploy checks (pre-merge / pre-rollout):
   - CI green for runtime + unit/integration tests (ENG-4521).
   - Perf smoke on canary infra (small cluster): automated bench with synthetic traces (long contexts).
   - Validate config: default quantization profile unchanged, autoscaler config pinned.
   - Notify #release-coordination 24h before start + PTO check.

2) Deploy to canary pool A (isolated hosts):
   - Target 5-10% of production ingress for 30 minutes.
   - Routing config: route by tenant weight via smart-router; pin a small set of internal tenants first (team-internal customers).
   - Monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency by model + token, per-route error rates, GPU memory pressure, OOM events, kernel timeouts.
   - Metrics dashboard: Release -> v2.15.0 canary dashboard (temp link in Confluence).

3) Canary validation gates (automated + manual):
   - Automated: latency check (no >15% p95 regression), errors <= baseline + 0.1% sustained for 20m, memory growth regression < 5% across 30m.
   - Manual: on-call SRE check-off after 30m, product sign-off for any heavy model regressions.

4) Ramp to 50% for 1–2 hours if gates pass
   - Run targeted prompts with eval corpus (open models + customer heavy prompts) to watch for quality regressions.
   - Keep a small canary subset pinned to v2.14.0 to compare outputs for a sample of requests (A/B style).

5) Full rollout in waves (50% -> 100%) with 15–30 minute stabilizations between waves.

Rollback strategy (fastest path):
- If automated gates fail during any ramp step: immediate rollback to v2.14.0 for affected pool via routing policy rollback (smart-router flag). Plan must be under 5 minutes to switch traffic.
- If a partial regression tied to kernel selection: set ENV OVERRIDE KERNEL=legacy on the new binary and restart nodes (slower fallback but avoids full rollback).
- If we see memory leaks: drain and replace nodes with previous image.

Version pinning notes:
- Model-serving compatibility: v2.15.0 changes kernel selection heuristics but keeps public model manifest schema identical. Pin important enterprise customers to v2.14.0 until after 72h stable.
- Flags to use: 
  - runtime_version=v2.15.0
  - kernel_policy=auto (default) / kernel_policy=legacy (fallback)
  - kv_cache_eviction=aggressive|conservative (default conservative)
- Update deployment manifests in infra repo: infra/deployments/prod/runtime.yaml -> set image: redwood/runtime:v2.15.0 and add annotation rollout=canary-2026-02.

Observability / dashboards to watch (critical):
- Per-route latency (p50/p95/p99) by model and token length (slice by long-context requests).
- GPU util + memory + encoder/decoder kernel timeouts.
- 5xx rate + client-side timeouts.
- KV cache hit ratio and eviction counts.
- Quality signal: sample diff rate between v2.14.0 and v2.15.0 for a subset of requests (use the eval harness).

Alert thresholds to escalate immediately:
- p95 latency > baseline * 1.25 for 15m -> page SRE and Product Lead.
- 5xx rate increase > 0.2% absolute over baseline for 10m -> page SRE.
- OOM/GPU OOM events -> page infra-sre immediately.

Checklist (quick actionable):
- [ ] Merge PR 987 and tag release image v2.15.0 (owner: Liam).
- [ ] Build Canary image and push to staging registry (owner: Liam).
- [ ] Run synthetic perf smoke on canary hosts (owner: Aisha).
- [ ] Update infra manifest with image + rollout annotation (owner: Ethan).
- [ ] Create canary dashboard and share link in #release-coordination (owner: Marisol).
- [ ] 24h pre-notice in #release-coordination + exec-notify if >50% traffic change (owner: Aisha).
- [ ] Coordinate AB sampling config (keep 5% pinned to v2.14.0) (owner: Product).
- [ ] Confirm rollback playbook in PagerDuty runbook (owner: SRE lead).

Open questions / risks (to surface):
- Is the kernel selection tweak fully backwards compatible for Llama-family models? Quick perf tests show improvement but need more coverage. (action: run regression harness across 10 commonly used open models).
- Some enterprise customers requested strict runtime pinning for a month after release; need to confirm list and make sure pinned tenants are excluded from canary weights. (action: CS + Account Mgmt to provide list).
- KV cache eviction 'aggressive' option reduces memory pressure but may change tail-latency profile for repeated contexts — monitor closely.

Post-release validation (24–72h):
- Keep increased sampling for output diffs for 72h.
- Export production eval metrics and run regression detection on new outputs vs baseline; file any quality regressions as follow-up tickets.
- Reconcile cost/throughput numbers and update Optimize recommendations if batching/quantization suggested changes.

Notes to self (rough):
- If anything looks off during canary, prefer immediate rollback. Don't try band-aids unless we can target a single config flag that addresses it quickly.
- Communicate loudly: customers notice small latency spikes; make sure comms team is ready for high-profile customers.
- After stable 72h window, prepare a short postmortem / release note for customers summarizing fixes and any config changes.

Useful links / refs (placeholders):
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-4521
- Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/1234567/RW-Release-2026-02

-- end scratchpad --
